title: Akiyama Mizuki — Reverse Hermit〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: What lies behind. What lies ahead.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I have nothing to talk about...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena's concerned and just wants to help me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And yet, she hasn't sent me any messages...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe it's her way of telling me to take it easy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But tomorrow, she'll probably be ready to bite my head off...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And she has every right to. I invited her out and just left her there all alone.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's all my fault.
I hope I can handle things the way I usually do...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Maybe I'll go to school tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Mizuki! Morning!
On time too! Good for you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks! C'mon, shower me with more praise♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! I might if you learn to come to school more often, like back-to-back days.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, I still can't believe what happened the other day! What are the odds that we'd run into each other like that?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane even told me afterward that you have a second-year from Miya Girls in your group.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane also said that she's never talked to her before, but she's an honor student who's good at sports and gets really good grades.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She's admired by her peers and they probably expect her to do great things.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Mafuyu hasn't actually told her parents or friends at school about what we do...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't worry! Kohane's not the type of person who blabs off to everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But it was also nice to finally meet Akito's sister.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I knew that she went to our school, but I never saw or heard anything about her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Probably because she attends night school.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, what did you think of her?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, she didn't seem like Akito's sister, you know...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: According to him, she's supposedly pretty difficult and not the easiest person to deal with...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (That's pretty much spot on, but I'll keep my mouth shut for Ena's sake.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was just thinking about the way I answered that question Akito's sister asked...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You said you're Mizuki's classmate, right, Shiraishi? I was wondering what Mizuki's like at school...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, the one about what I'm like at school...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The fact that I get good grades was great and all, but mentioning how all the teachers are watching me like hawks might've been a bit much...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
How? It's true, right?
Oh, I should've talked about how you cut class even when you do come to school.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But I'm here today, aren't I?
Don't I get points for that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Again, you need to learn to come to school on a regular basis. I mean, you get good grades, so you could even help me study by coming more often.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! Can't you just study on your own?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I hope that response told Ena that everything's just fine...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She gave me a quick glance before answering Ena's questions, which was probably her way of sticking up for me...)
